Method of Attack: Phishing campaign using smishing SMS messages impersonating Monzo to lure users to phishing websites; Phishing sites created with Cazanova Morphine kit displaying fake login forms to steal Monzo account credentials; Use of stolen credentials to verify new devices via 'golden link' sent by Monzo email; Potential bypass of 2FA via social engineering or OTP stealing bots
Attack Vector: Smishing SMS messages with links to phishing websites; Phishing websites hosted on Russian IP space (NForce Entertainment AS43350) with domains registered via Guangdong-based registrars (Eranet and NiceNic)
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing domains: monzo-notice.com, monzo-online-support.com, monzo-check.com, monzo-card-support.com, monzo-replacement.com, alert-monzo.com; Phishing sites hosted on CIDRs in Russian IP space with ASN AS43350; Domains registered via Eranet and NiceNic registrars; Phishing landing page kit: Cazanova Morphine
